Name: JojaMart Sells It Too
Author: Sable17
Description:
[size=1][quote]I just really don't want to shop at Pierre's...[/quote][/size]
[color=#6fa8dc][b]JojaMart [/b][/color]sells it too Pierre!

[b][color=#6fa8dc]JojaMart [/color][/b]now sells[b] Fruit Tree Saplings[/b] and traditional [b]Fertilizers[/b] at the back of the store![list]
[*][b]Basic Fertilizer[/b], [b]Basic Retaining Soil[/b], [b]Speed-Gro[/b] are [b]for sale from day 1[/b]. 2 weeks before Pierre would get it in stock.
[*][b]Quality Fertilizer[/b], [b]Quality Retaining Soil[/b], [b]Deluxe Speed-Gro[/b] will be [b]for sale starting Winter 15[/b]. 2 weeks before Pierre would get it in stock. Suck it Pierre!
(The Saplings from Stardew Valley Expanded, Cornucopia More Crops, & Cornucopia More Flowers will be sold there as well, if you have them installed!)
[/list]All [b]10%[/b] cheaper than Pierre's.

[b][color=#6d9eeb]JojaMart [/color][/b]now sells the following at the [b]ends of the checkout aisles[/b]:
[list]
[*][b]Bouquet[/b]
[*][b]Grass Starter Recipe[/b]
[*][b]Dehydrator Recipe[/b]
[*][b]Catalog[/b]
[/list]All [b]10%[/b] cheaper than Pierre's.

[b][color=#6d9eeb]JojaMart [/color][/b]now sells the following at the [b]main JojaMart store[/b]:[list]
[*][b]Artichoke[/b], [b]Red Cabbage[/b], and [b]Garlic Seeds[/b], sold in their respective season, starting in [b]Year 2[/b].
[/list]All [b]10%[/b] cheaper than Pierre's.

[b][color=#6fa8dc]JojaMart [/color][/b]now sells [b]backpacks[/b]! (Same price as default, but at least you don't have to stare at Pierre's face.)

[b]Also:
[/b][list]
[*][b]Moves [/b][b]Sugar[/b], [b]Wheat Flour[/b], and [b]Rice [/b]from the main JojaMart store, to [b][u]Aisle D[/u][/b] instead.
[*]Adds [b]Vinegar[/b], [b]Oil[/b], and [b]basic Mayonnaise [/b]for sale there as well.
[/list]All [b]10%[/b] cheaper than Pierre's.


No reason not to continue shopping while at your local JojaMart! Check out: 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37717]JojaPantry [/url]for canned produce, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37365]JojaSweets Candy[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38012]JojaFizzy Energy Drinks[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37232]JojaBite TV Dinners [/url], or[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38341] JojaFresh Healthy Snacks[/url] for more Joja snacks!

Want a supplier Contract? Try [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39398]JojaGrowers[/url]! For flexible JojaJobs, try [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38103]JojaFlex - Freelance Contracts[/url]. There's also [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39109]JojaGrowth Fertilizer[/url] for your fields!
[b]
Requirements[/b]
• Stardew Valley 1.6+
• SMAPI
• Content Patcher

Doesn't directly edit the JojaMart map. Should be compatible with mods that edit the store, as long as they don't place anything in the same spot.
Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded. (Used in Screenshots. Also in screenshot: Soft Farmer, VPR-Inspired UI, a bunch of my Joja mods.)

Downloads.Description: Patch to match the colors of Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn. Overwrite main file.
JojaMart now sells most of what Pierre does, 10% cheaper!
